notes.title: Update - Version 1.1.1
notes.content:
Version 1.1.1 brings some UX/UI changes, visual and gameplay enhancement, and bug fixes.
Here is a brief overview of what changed:

UX Enhancement

 Added keyboard control. You can now use arrow keys (Left/Right) to flip pages.

Visuals

 Speed up the game menu on the title screen.
 Speed up animations for some pages to enhance readability.

Gameplay

 Added guide for crab-eating minigame.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed game crash upon entering title screen.
 Fixed hitting the space bar resulting game crash.
 Fixed bugs on BGM and BGA sliders resulting in sudden gain.


Enjoy! And please let me know if you need any help.
